methods.name: Metadata decode(MetadataInputBuffer inputBuffer)
methods.comment:
* Decodes a {@link Metadata} element from the provided input buffer. * *

Respects {@link ByteBuffer#limit()} of {@code inputBuffer.data}, but assumes {@link * ByteBuffer#position()} and {@link ByteBuffer#arrayOffset()} are both zero and {@link * ByteBuffer#hasArray()} is true. * * @param inputBuffer The input buffer to decode. * @return The decoded metadata object, or {@code null} if the metadata could not be decoded or if * {@link MetadataInputBuffer#isDecodeOnly()} was set on the input buffer.
